_comment: AGENT-EDITABLE sizing policy. Hard caps live in config/protected.json and always win.
sizing_notes: Flat $5. min_edge lowered 0.07->0.04 for the data-collection phase (cycle 1): with zero settled positions, loop count and calibration data are worth more than per-bet EV. Revisit at n>=50 settled.
edge_class_notes: DEEP-2026-07-31: min_edge_book_devig (0.07 = 0.04 base + ~0.03 buffer covering proportional-devig longshot bias (~0.5-1.5c measured on entry odds), scraped-line staleness, and the sharp-counterparty prior on tight books; at n=7 the buffer size is a judgment call) applies to edges derived solely from devigging scraped bookmaker odds against a tight PM book — that class went 0/7 while structural edges went 2/2. Structural edges (information race, cross-market inconsistency) keep min_edge 0.04. max_stake_per_event_usd caps correlated sibling/derivative legs on one underlying event (evidence: CONN@CHI spread+ML -$10, and two open $10 pairs). If book-devig placements drop to ~zero, revisit whether 0.07 should apply only to proportional-devig numbers (power devig already removes the bias).
